text: e A recursive algorithm to return the Rank of a node z. Assume T is the root node of the tree and node x is the node for which we are trying to determine the rank. The algorithm below returns the rank of z, assuming x exists in the tree. It searches down a path in the tree, and has a runtime of O(h). RecursiveRank(Tx) ifT =z if Tleft | = NIL return (T.left.size + 1) else return 1 if T.key < z.key L=1 if Tleft ! = NIL L += T.left.size return RecursiveRank(T.right,x) + L else return RecursiveRank(T left,x)
